name: eliot-governor
description: LEGACY COMPATIBILITY FIXTURE (#18): exposes the eliot-governor facade to Claude Desktop pending migration to bins/eliot-agent-bridge. Not the production Governor.
long_description: COMPATIBILITY FIXTURE, issue #18 (Claude Desktop MCPB server entry point). Reads current task truth, expands exact evidence, uses governed memory, delegates bounded work, and submits receipted candidate or verification results through the legacy eliot-governor facade only. The production route is bins/eliot-agent-bridge + crates/surfaces/* once that owner implements this consumer's protocol (mcp stdio --host claude-desktop --instance default); eliot-agent-bridge today requires --profile/--transport/--client-declaration and implements no --host/--instance argv, and eliot-claude-sidecar is unavailable-target per integrations/claude/route-profile.json. Remove when the packaged server entry point is a current root binary under #11. Claude identity never grants a permanent role.

_legacy_compatibility.consumer: Claude Desktop MCPB server entry point
_legacy_compatibility.owner_gap: eliot-agent-bridge requires --profile/--transport/--client-declaration (bins/eliot-agent-bridge/src/cli_contract.rs) and has no --host/--instance argv; eliot-claude-sidecar is unavailable-target (integrations/claude/route-profile.json)
_legacy_compatibility.expiry: remove when the packaged server entry point is a current root binary under #11
